import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    s = t/(1+t)
    return (-params[0]*t/(params[1]+t) + params[2]*P*s + params[3]*P + params[4]*P**2*s + params[5]*P**2
            + params[6]*P**3 + params[7]*P*t + params[8]*P**2*t + params[9]*P**3*t)
